# Semantic Memory Search

Enhance the Memory Layer with semantic search capabilities that understand intent, not just keywords. Use embeddings to find relevant context even when exact terms differ. Prioritize recent and frequently-used memories.

## Rationale
Addresses a critical competitor pain point - Cursor (pain-1-3), aider (pain-4-4), and Claude Code CLI (pain-5-4) all lack persistent memory. This strengthens Turret's key differentiator and helps agents make better decisions by surfacing relevant past context.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want the agent to remember our architectural decisions so that it makes consistent choices across sessions
- As a power user, I want to search my project memory using natural language so that I can verify what context the agent has

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given a natural language query, the system finds semantically similar memories even if wording differs
- [ ] Memory relevance scores are visible to users
- [ ] Agents automatically retrieve relevant memories when starting new tasks
- [ ] Memory retrieval latency is under 500ms for typical queries
